meta.name: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion!
meta.description: Rose, a lone witch who lives quietly by the lake, is asked by the knight she secretly loves to brew a love potion—for someone else. Though heartbroken, she cannot refuse him, choosing instead to treasure the fleeting time they spend together gathering ingredients. And as the days quietly slip by, Rose finds herself clinging to each shared moment, dreading the day the potion is finally complete.

videos.title: The Witch and the Love Potion of Unrequited Love
videos.overview: The Witch of the Lake, Rose, falls for a knight, who later visits her seeking a love potion.

videos.title: The Good Witch of the Lake
videos.overview: Rose finds herself being conscious of her looks while Harij begins to wonder about her disheveled lifestyle.

videos.title: The Black Tea Scented Witch's Song
videos.overview: With every visit, Harij helps Rose realize things she's overlooked before. Even of a certain song she sings.

videos.title: A Knight's Duty Even Unknown to the Witch
videos.overview: Harij continues to feel pressured to accomplish his mission, though something inside himself begins to change.

videos.title: To Be a Witch
videos.overview: As time passes, Rose begins to realize the impact Harij is having on her life. However, to live as a witch...

videos.title: The Witch and the Promised Love Potion
videos.overview: With the potion complete, Rose explains to Harij how to use it, when he makes a shocking request to test it.

videos.title: The One to Cast a Spell on the Princess Is a Witch
videos.overview: With only one month before her wedding, Billaura took Harij's word to heart and decided to make a bold move.

videos.title: Witch of the Sleeping Forest
videos.overview: Finding it hard to believe that Rose ever gets to rest, Harij takes it upon himself to make sure she sleeps.
